topics.title: Pricing, Rates & Quotes
topics.summary: Inquiries regarding daily rates, multi-day tiered discounts, and currency quotes.
frequently_asked_questions: How much does it cost to rent a motorbike per day?
Do you offer multi-day or weekly discounts?
Can I pay in US Dollars, Credit Card, or Thai Baht cash?
topics.verified_answer: Daily rental rates range from ฿250 THB/day for city scooters (Honda Click) up to ฿1,800 THB/day for heavy touring bikes (Honda Transalp 750). We offer tiered discounts for 4-7 day rentals (~15% off) and 8+ day rentals (~25% off). We accept THB cash, Thai PromptPay, major Credit Cards, and Wise/Revolut.

topics.title: Monthly & Long-Term Rentals
topics.summary: Inquiries for 30+ day rentals, expat packages, and monthly maintenance.
frequently_asked_questions: Do you offer monthly rates for motorbike rentals?
What is included in a monthly rental contract?
Is routine maintenance included during long-term rental?
topics.verified_answer: Yes! Monthly rates start at ฿3,500 THB/month for 125cc scooters up to ฿22,000 THB/month for 500cc adventure touring bikes. Monthly contracts include free routine servicing (oil changes every 2,000 km), helmet rentals, and 24/7 roadside assistance in Chiang Mai province.

topics.topic: Mae Hong Son / Samoeng Loop & Routes
topics.title: Route Suitability & Loop Recommendations
topics.summary: Inquiries about mountain loops, steep hill climbs, and luggage/passenger capabilities.
frequently_asked_questions: Which bike is best for the Mae Hong Son Loop (1,864 curves)?
Can a 160cc scooter (PCX / NMAX) handle two riders on mountain climbs?
Do you provide top boxes or side panniers for luggage?
topics.verified_answer: For the famous Mae Hong Son Loop or Pai trip, we highly recommend 300cc+ adventure bikes or premium scooters (Honda ADV 350, Forza 350, Triumph Scrambler 400X, or Honda NX500). For two riders with luggage, 300cc+ is essential. 125cc-160cc scooters are great for Doi Suthep and Samoeng Loop.

topics.title: Delivery, Hotel & Airport Services
topics.summary: Inquiries about hotel delivery, CNX Airport pickup, and shop operating hours.
frequently_asked_questions: Can you deliver the bike to my hotel or apartment in Chiang Mai?
Do you offer pickup or drop-off at Chiang Mai Airport (CNX)?
Where is your main shop located?
topics.verified_answer: We deliver directly to hotels, apartments, and guest houses in Nimman, Old City, and Santitham for ฿100-200 THB, or free for 5+ day rentals. We also arrange CNX Airport transfers and hotel pickups. Our main shop is located at Sridonchai Road, near Night Bazaar.

topics.title: License, Deposit & Passport Requirements
topics.summary: Inquiries about International Driving Permits (IDP), security deposits, and passport retention.
frequently_asked_questions: Do I need an International Driving Permit (IDP) to rent a bike in Thailand?
What is the security deposit requirement?
Do I have to leave my original passport as a deposit?
topics.verified_answer: An International Driving Permit (IDP Class A for motorcycles) or valid motorcycle license is required by Thai traffic law. For security deposit, you can either leave ฿1,000 - ฿5,000 THB cash (depending on model) OR leave your passport copy with deposit cash.

topics.title: Accessories, Helmets & Gear
topics.summary: Inquiries about full-face helmets, phone holders, rain gear, and luggage racks.
frequently_asked_questions: Are helmets included with the rental?
Do bikes come equipped with phone holders for GPS navigation?

topics.verified_answer: Every rental includes two sanitized open-face or full-face helmets and a phone holder for GPS map navigation free of charge. Raincoats, luggage racks, and top boxes are available upon request.
